palette.hint: Drag a stage onto a pipeline.

inspector.hint: Select a watch, a pipeline or a stage to edit it.
inspector.name: Name

output.empty: Trigger the watch to see where each file goes.

filter.about: Lets files through by extension or name pattern; first in a pipeline it claims files, later it drops them.

parameters.ext: Extensions, any case, without the dot.
parameters.glob: A file name pattern; with ext, both must match.
parameters.invert: Inverts the result, to drop what matches.

number.about: Takes one number out of a field, such as the episode or season.

parameters.from: The field to look in; name by default.
parameters.nth: Which candidate to take; negative counts from the end.
parameters.prefix: Only the number right after this word, such as Season.
parameters.exclude: Skips the current values of these fields, so a season is not taken for an episode.

regex.about: Captures or rewrites a field with a regular expression, for what the built-in stages cannot do.

parameters.pattern: The regular expression; named groups become fields.
parameters.from: The field to match; name by default.
parameters.into: Writes the whole match into this field.
parameters.replace: Rewrites the match instead of capturing it.

set.about: Sets fixed values, replacing what the fields held.

default.about: Fills fixed values only into fields still unset; place it after the captures.

replace.about: Replaces literal text in a field.

parameters.with: The text to put in its place.
parameters.field: The field to rewrite; name by default.

case.about: Changes the case of a field.

parameters.field: The field to rewrite; name by default.

strip.about: Removes bracketed tags and tidies the spaces left.

parameters.groups: The brackets to remove; only [] by default.
parameters.field: The field to rewrite; name by default.

format.about: Builds the file name from a template; the extension is added at the end.
format.value: The name template, such as {show} s{season:02}e{episode:02}.

folder.about: Adds folders under the target from a template.

parameters.to: A folder name pattern; lifts to the nearest folder that matches.

lift.value: How many levels to move up.

next.about: For a field still unset, takes the highest value among the files already at the target, plus one.

parameters.like: The template existing names are matched by; the into field is the part counted.

rank.about: Orders and numbers the files of a group, such as several subtitles.

parameters.into: The field to write the number into.
parameters.by: The fields files are grouped by.
parameters.prefer: Files whose original name holds these come first.

take.about: Copies fields to a subtitle from the video whose name it starts with.

parameters.from: The pipeline to take from; all earlier ones by default.

move.about: Moves the file to its planned path, never overwriting a file.

parameters.on_conflict: On a clash, reject refuses; suffix retries once with a suffix.
parameters.suffix: The suffix added on a clash; _v2 by default.

cleanup.about: Removes folders the move emptied, only inside the unit.

parameters.keep: Folders matching these patterns are kept.
